 Today’s Turkish League match schedule and broadcast channels 
 Football fans will be glued to their screens this Sunday, November 1, 2026, for a series of highly anticipated matches across Europe. As the major leagues continue their competition, the clash between Liverpool and Arsenal headlines the English Premier League. Meanwhile, Real Madrid faces a test against Racing Santander in La Liga.
 Today’s matches feature important encounters across multiple leagues. Juventus will face Napoli in Serie A, while La Liga will host several notable matches, including Athletic Bilbao vs. Real Sociedad, Getafe vs. Sevilla, and Elche vs. Valencia.
 In the Turkish league, the competition continues with several matches. The most notable of these is Trabzonspor’s match against Gaziantep, while Kasimpasa faces Besiktas. Both teams will be aiming for three points in these encounters.
 Today’s Premier League fixtures and broadcast channels
 Liverpool vs Arsenal: 8:30 PM UAE time, 6:30 PM Egypt time, and 7:30 PM Saudi time, on beIN SPORTS 1.
 Today’s Spanish League fixtures and broadcast channels
 Getafe vs Sevilla: 5:00 PM UAE time, 3:00 PM Egypt time, and 4:00 PM Saudi Arabia time, on beIN SPORTS 3.
 Racing Santander vs Real Madrid: 7:15 PM UAE time, 5:15 PM Egypt time, and 6:15 PM Saudi Arabia time, via beIN SPORTS 2.
 Elche vs Valencia: 9:30 PM UAE time, 7:30 PM Egypt time, and 8:30 PM Saudi time, on beIN SPORTS 3.
 Athletic Bilbao vs Real Sociedad: 12:00 midnight UAE time, early Monday morning November 2, 10:00 PM Egypt time, and 11:00 PM Saudi Arabia time, on beIN SPORTS 1.
 Today’s Italian League fixtures
 Juventus vs Napoli: 11:45 PM UAE time, 9:45 PM Egypt time, 10:45 PM Saudi Arabia time.
 Today’s Turkish League match schedule and broadcast channels
 Trabzonspor vs Gaziantep: 5:00 PM UAE time, 3:00 PM Egypt time, and 4:00 PM Saudi time, on beIN SPORTS 1.
 Kasimpasa vs Besiktas: 8:00 PM UAE time, 6:00 PM Egypt time, and 7:00 PM Saudi time, on beIN SPORTS 6.
 The clash between Liverpool and Arsenal is one of the highlights of Sunday’s fixtures. The match between Juventus and Napoli also stands out. Meanwhile, in Spain, all eyes will be on Real Madrid’s encounter with Racing Santander. This is all part of a packed schedule of football matches for fans of the beautiful game.
